author: kalebcullen
quote: I was going to buy this game and was very exited to play, I watched streamers play it and it looked boring. There are no new game mechanics that are out of this world, the tremendous amount of bugs found by players shouldn't happen when a game has been developed for so long. Rockstar spent over 1 billion dollars to make a game that is mediocre  . Im not buying a game that wont even run properly and a smooth good framerate. 30 fps doesn't cut it. I would rather play gta5
